content.text:
<subagent sessionID="ses_e3ea7dc57ffe2kANCmzG52uKaE" state="completed">
## Repository overview

- **Game entry point:** [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html ) — the complete game is a single HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript.
- **Framework:** No game framework or build system is present. It uses native HTML/CSS and the browser’s **2D Canvas API**.
- **Project guidance:** [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/Agents.md`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/Agents.md )
- **README:** [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md ) is primarily OMGithub project links; it does not document local build steps.
- **Runtime scripts:** [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh ) delegates to an OMGithub runtime script via `RUNTIME_DIR`; [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/capture.sh`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/capture.sh ) delegates capture similarly.

## Gameplay and controls

The game is **Pizza Panic**, a top-down maze chase. The player moves through a fixed tile maze, collects eight golden toppings, and tries to evade a sentient pizza before the 60-second timer expires. The pizza pursues the player directly and phases through walls. Players have three lives; collisions cost a life and 50 points, with temporary invulnerability and a respawn. Collecting all toppings wins, and remaining time adds to the score.

- **Desktop:** WASD or arrow keys to move; Space to dash.
- **Mobile:** On-screen drag joystick and dash button.
- **Other mechanics:** Dash cooldown, sound toggle using synthesized Web Audio tones, animated collectibles, particles, collision effects, screen shake, and HUD updates.

## Styling

The inline styles in `index.html` define a responsive, dark arcade layout with warm pizza-themed accents, a score/lives/slices/time HUD, start/end overlay, and mobile-specific sizing and controls. The canvas game art—including the maze, player, pizza pursuer, and collectibles—is drawn in JavaScript.

## Run/build

There is no `package.json`, dependency installation, or project build step. For local play, serve the repository as static files—for example, run `python3 -m http.server 8000` from the repository directory and open `http://localhost:8000/`. The repository’s `start.sh` is specific to the OMGithub runtime and requires `RUNTIME_DIR`; it is not a standalone build command.
</subagent>

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Add a main menu to Pizza Panic and support a build mode where players create mazes and customize their pizza chaser.

## Requirements
- Build a complete, playable game change without asking questions.
- Save any screenshot checks as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Implemented the menu and maze/chaser builder directly in the existing single-file HTML game.
- Builder supports wall/erase/start-marker tools, chaser name/color/toppings/speed controls, local save, and test mode.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added menu actions for arcade play and maze building.
- Added maze editing and chaser customization; saved builds use browser local storage.
- Arcade mode resets to the default maze and chaser; builder test mode plays the customized build.
- Extracted inline JavaScript and verified syntax with `node --check /tmp/pizza-script.js`.
- Opened the page in Playwright and captured/read menu and builder JPEG screenshots.

### Active
- Validate builder UI interactions after the latest toolbar pointer-event and toppings changes.

### Blocked
- Browser check was not repeated after the latest edits.

## Next Move
1. Reload the page and verify builder controls respond to clicks while the canvas remains editable.
2. Test saving, reloading, and playing a customized maze/chaser; inspect console errors and take a fresh JPEG screenshot.
3. Check `git status` and summarize the final changes; changes remain uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game, main menu, builder UI, gameplay logic, and styling.

## Important Context
- A local static server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Playwright browser is installed and the page was opened at `http://localhost:3002/`.
- A builder screenshot was captured at `/tmp/opencode/pizza-builder.jpg` before the most recent UI tweaks.

## Objective
- Add a main menu to Pizza Panic and support a playable build mode for custom mazes and pizza chasers.

## Requirements
- Complete the game change without asking questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save screenshot checks as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Implemented the menu and builder in the existing single-file HTML game.
- Builder includes wall/erase/start-marker tools, chaser name/color/toppings/speed controls, local save, and test mode.
- Arcade play resets to the default maze and chaser; builder test mode uses the custom build.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added arcade and maze-builder menu actions.
- Added maze editing and chaser customization with browser local storage.
- Verified builder toolbar and controls respond to clicks; canvas tile edits and saving were exercised in Playwright.
- Verified saved maze and chaser settings, including a placed wall and custom name, speed, and toppings.
- Extracted inline JavaScript and passed `node --check /tmp/pizza-script.js`.
- Captured and inspected menu and builder JPEG screenshots earlier in the work.

### Active
- Validate save/reload and playing a customized maze/chaser after the latest edits.
- Capture a fresh screenshot and inspect browser console errors.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Reload and verify the saved maze/chaser settings persist.
2. Test the customized maze, verify gameplay and menu return behavior, and inspect console errors.
3. Capture and read a fresh JPEG screenshot, then check `git status` and summarize.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game, main menu, builder UI, gameplay logic, and styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local static server is running at `http://localhost:3002/`; Playwright is open on the page.
- Screenshots previously captured: `/tmp/opencode/pizza-main.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/pizza-builder.jpg`; they predate the latest edits.
